purpose: Offline high-drift Madrid benchmark design; not fully online month scheduling
paper_relationship: Inspired by STBP Appendix A.4.1/Table6 grouped MMD analysis; kernel, estimator and month-selection procedure below are our explicit new protocol
source_scope: Every available month in 2022-2025 and January-October 2026; exactly 58 audited candidates
data_scope: Only each month's chronological first floor(source_steps*0.6) observations; no validation/test reads
node_cohort: Fixed 128 original IDs selected using January 2022 training data, seed42; same IDs compared between months
input_fill: Chronological forward fill within each training segment; initial fallback is January 2022 training-fitted per-node median
normalization: January 2022 per-node valid-value mean/std frozen; std floor is the 5th percentile of positive January anchor stds; no per-month refit

samples.construction: Disjoint blocks starting at 0,12,...; choose 64 equally spaced block indices using floor(linspace(0,blocks-1,64)); sample day is the real source start date

kernel.node_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-node kernels over same IDs meeting coverage in both months
kernel.gamma_squared_fit: Median positive squared distance of 512 seeded ordered nonself window-pairs per January reference node, pooled across all128 nodes; fixed across all comparisons

statistic: Biased MMD squared V-statistic including self terms, followed by sqrt(max(MMD_squared,0)); exact finite-sample kernel calculation
objective: Maximize the sum of four adjacent-year MMD values, NOT the sum of MMD squared
optimization: Five-layer dynamic program over eligible month candidates; deterministic lexical tie break, retain ten best paths
added_nodes: Not used to select months; document separately after building final tasks
paper_threshold: STBP MMD>0.1 threshold is not transferred to this explicitly different kernel/sample protocol
p_values: Selected transitions only: whole-real-date block label permutations, fixed number of date blocks in group A, actual sample-count denominators, (1+exceedances)/(permutations+1). Post-selection descriptive values only; no uncorrected confirmatory significance claim
